Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.description: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

information_collection.title: Information We Collect
information_collection.content: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, upload plugins, or contact us. This may include your name, email address, username, and any content you submit.

information_use.title: How We Use Your Information
information_use.content: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process transactions, send communications, and comply with legal obligations.

data_protection.title: Data Protection
data_protection.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, analyze usage patterns, and provide personalized content.

third_party.title: Third-Party Services
third_party.content: We may use third-party services for analytics, authentication, and other functionalities. These services have their own privacy policies.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through our support channels.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.description: Terms and conditions for using exteraStore platform.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using exteraStore, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement.

services.title: Description of Services
services.content: exteraStore is a platform for discovering, sharing, and managing plugins for exteraGram. We provide tools for developers to publish their plugins and for users to discover and install them.

user_accounts.title: User Accounts
user_accounts.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account information and for all activities that occur under your account.

plugin_uploads.title: Plugin Uploads
plugin_uploads.content: Users may upload plugins subject to our content guidelines. You retain ownership of your plugins but grant us a license to distribute them through our platform.

prohibited_uses.title: Prohibited Uses
prohibited_uses.content: You may not use our service for any unlawful purpose or to solicit others to perform unlawful acts. You may not upload malicious content or violate intellectual property rights.

intellectual_property.title: Intellectual Property
intellectual_property.content: The service and its original content, features, and functionality are and will remain the exclusive property of exteraStore and its licensors.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: We may terminate or suspend your account and bar access to the service immediately, without prior notice, for conduct that we believe violates these Terms.

limitation_liability.title: Limitation of Liability
limitation_liability.content: In no event shall exteraStore be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the service.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify or replace these Terms at any time. If a revision is material, we will provide at least 30 days notice prior to any new terms taking effect.

contact.title: Contact Information
contact.content: Questions about the Terms of Service should be sent to us through our support channels.

Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.description: How we use cookies and similar technologies on exteraStore.

what_are_cookies.title: What Are Cookies
what_are_cookies.content: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit our website. They help us provide you with a better experience by remembering your preferences and understanding how you use our service.

how_we_use.title: How We Use Cookies
how_we_use.content: We use cookies to maintain your session, remember your language preferences, analyze site usage, and provide personalized content. This helps us improve our service and provide you with a better user experience.

types_of_cookies.title: Types of Cookies We Use
types_of_cookies.content: We use essential cookies for basic functionality, analytics cookies to understand usage patterns, and preference cookies to remember your settings like language and theme preferences.

manage_cookies.title: Managing Cookies
manage_cookies.content: You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about our Cookie Policy, please contact us through our support channels.
